name: comp-590

frames.best_why: The team menu is open with all three team names while the full bar stays visible.

tagline: Creator app header with a team switcher, icon nav and a white Post button.
summary: A compact dark header pairing a team pill with four icon-only nav links, a white plus Post button, a notification bell and a user avatar.
appearance: A dark header with a rounded team pill showing a letter avatar and team name, four icon-only nav links (home, compass, feather, search), a white plus Post button, a bell with an unread dot and a round user avatar.
behaviour: Clicking the team pill drops a short menu of team names; choosing one swaps the avatar letter and label then closes the menu. The nav icons only react on hover.
demo_content: Teams are Acme Inc., coss.com and Junon; nav icons stand for Dashboard, Explore, Write and Search.
search_phrases: content app header with team switcher
use_when: A content or social app needs a team switcher and a quick create button in a compact bar.
avoid_when: Nav items are icon-only with no visible labels, and the team names are hardcoded.
customise: Team names and nav icons are written in the file; the notification and user menus come from separate components.
weight_why: A team pill, four icon links and three small buttons.

a11y.note: Icon links have screen-reader text, but naming for the bell and avatar depends on the separate menu components.

polish_why: Compact, well-spaced creator header with a working team menu; icons are small.
